Commonwealth/Edgeware has so much more going on than I previously realized! Thanks for the info. Look forward to exploring.

Would also recommend the [Polkadot governance](https://wiki.polkadot.network/docs/en/learn-governance) guide, in addition to the resources Rich pointed out above. It probably is the most concise summary of the underlying tech (of course, refer to the Edgeware blog for how we've deployed it).

In general I'd head to [the documentation](https://main.edgeware.wiki/edgeware-runtime/governance) and this [Edgeware guide](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-guide/). It uses Substrate which is also the basis for Polkadot and Kusama - so also worth reviewing the [Substrate core documentation](https://substrate.dev).
